args.body:
label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The running locally steps in the README currently mention MinIO as an option without stating that S3_ENDPOINT needs to be configured or that the bucket must be created. Updating README.md to include these instructions will help users avoid connection errors when running locally with MinIO.
